newsitem.title: USA: New World Coffee submits amended filing.
newsitem.headline: New World Coffee submits amended filing.

text.p: New World Coffee Inc said Monday that it has submitted an amended filing showing that a company officer and a director have bought company shares.
The original filing incorrectly said board member Keith Barket and Chief Financial Officer Jerald Novack had sold the shares.
The amended filing indicates Barket bought 8,000 of New World's company stock, and Novack bought 5,000 shares.
Both transactions occurred between September 18 and September 24, the company said.
